results.question: Which paying bank had the highest technical decline rate in October 2025?
results.sql: SELECT bank AS bank_name, td_pct AS decline_rate FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND month = DATE '2025-10-01' ORDER BY td_pct DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What was State Bank of India's technical decline rate as a paying bank in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT td_pct AS tech_decline_rate FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'State Bank of India' AND month = '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter'

results.question: How many paying banks kept technical declines under 1% in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT count(bank) AS bank_count FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter' AND td_pct < 1

results.question: How many paying banks kept technical declines under 1% in January 2022?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS bank_count FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2022-01-01' AND side = 'remitter' AND td_pct < 1.0

results.question: Which paying bank handled the most UPI payments in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT bank FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter' ORDER BY volume_mn DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many UPI payments, in millions, went through the top 50 paying banks in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(volume_mn) AS total_volume_mn FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter'

results.question: Which receiving bank had the highest technical decline rate in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT bank AS bank, td_pct AS technical_decline_rate FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'beneficiary' AND month = DATE '2026-09-01' ORDER BY td_pct DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What was HDFC Bank's business decline rate as a paying bank in June 2023?
results.sql: SELECT bd_pct AS decline_rate FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'HDFC Bank' AND side = 'remitter' AND month = DATE '2023-06-01'

results.question: Which 3 paying banks had the highest business decline rates in August 2026?
results.sql: SELECT bank, bd_pct AS decline_rate FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND month = DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY bd_pct DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: In which month did Airtel Payments Bank have its highest business decline rate as a paying bank?
results.sql: SELECT month FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'Airtel Payments Bank' AND side = 'remitter' ORDER BY bd_pct DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What was the technical decline rate across all top 50 paying banks in September 2026, weighted by payments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(td_pct * volume_mn) / SUM(volume_mn) AS avg_td_pct FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND month = DATE '2026-09-01'

results.question: How many payments banks were among the top 50 paying banks in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT bank) AS count_banks FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter' AND bank_type = 'payments bank'

results.question: Which public sector bank had the highest technical decline rate as a paying bank in December 2025?
results.sql: SELECT bank, td_pct FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND bank_type = 'public sector bank' AND month = DATE '2025-12-01' ORDER BY td_pct DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What was ICICI Bank's technical decline rate as a paying bank over all of 2025, weighted by payments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(td_pct * volume_mn) / SUM(volume_mn) AS weighted_td_rate FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'ICICI Bank' AND side = 'remitter' AND month >= '2025-01-01' AND month <= '2025-12-01'

results.question: In how many months was Bank of Baroda's technical decline rate as a paying bank above 1%?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS months_above_1pct FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'Bank of Baroda' AND side = 'remitter' AND td_pct > 1

results.question: How many different banks appear in the data?
results.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT bank) AS bank_count FROM bank_month

results.question: What was the highest technical decline rate of any paying bank in 2022, and which bank and month was it?
results.sql: SELECT td_pct AS highest_td_pct, bank AS bank_name, month AS month FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND YEAR(month) = 2022 ORDER BY td_pct DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What were SBI's technical decline rates as a paying bank in August and September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT month, td_pct FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'State Bank of India' AND side = 'remitter' AND month IN (DATE '2026-08-01', DATE '2026-09-01')

results.question: Which small finance bank handled the most payments as a paying bank in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT bank, volume_mn FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter' AND bank_type = 'small finance bank' ORDER BY volume_mn DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many paying banks had a business decline rate above 10% in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM bank_month WHERE month = '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter' AND bd_pct > 10

results.question: How many UPI payments did Paytm Payments Bank receive in January 2022, in millions?
results.sql: SELECT volume_mn FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'Paytm Payments Bank' AND side = 'beneficiary' AND month = DATE '2022-01-01'

results.question: What share of the top 50 paying banks' payments in September 2026 went through State Bank of India, in %?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bank = 'State Bank of India' THEN volume_mn ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(volume_mn) AS share_pct FROM bank_month WHERE month = '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter'

results.question: Which month had the most UPI payments through the top 50 paying banks?
results.sql: SELECT month, SUM(volume_mn) AS total_vol FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' GROUP BY month ORDER BY total_vol DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What was the business decline rate across all top 50 paying banks in 2023, weighted by payments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(bd_pct * volume_mn) / SUM(volume_mn) AS avg_bd_rate FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND month >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND month <= DATE '2023-12-01'

results.question: Which paying banks had a technical decline rate of 1% or more in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT bank AS bank_name, td_pct AS technical_decline_rate FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND td_pct >= 1.0

results.question: In which month was Kotak Mahindra Bank's technical decline rate as a paying bank at its highest?
results.sql: SELECT month AS month FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'Kotak Mahindra Bank' AND side = 'remitter' ORDER BY td_pct DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many regional rural banks were among the top 50 paying banks in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bank) AS bank_count FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND side = 'remitter' AND bank_type = 'regional rural bank'

results.question: How many UPI payments did Airtel Payments Bank send in 2025, in millions?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(volume_mn) AS total_volume FROM bank_month WHERE bank = 'Airtel Payments Bank' AND side = 'remitter' AND month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month <= DATE '2025-12-01'

results.question: Which type of bank had the highest technical decline rate among paying banks in September 2026, weighted by payments?
results.sql: SELECT bank_type AS type, SUM(td_pct * volume_mn) / SUM(volume_mn) AS avg_td FROM bank_month WHERE side = 'remitter' AND month = DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY bank_type ORDER BY avg_td DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Mar 2024 mein sabse zyada business decline kis bank ka tha?
results.sql: SELECT bank FROM bank_month WHERE month = DATE '2024-03-01' ORDER BY bd_pct DESC LIMIT 1
